shots.focal_element: A sequence of recreated product UI moments on an off-white canvas: the swirling gradient agent orb, a two-sided chat transcript that types in sync with the voice-over, transcript analysis lists, an audio playback card, evaluation/summary cards, a multilingual '32 languages' type moment, a Spanish chat, an embed-code card with cursor copy, and a 'Need help? / Start a call' widget.
on_screen_text: Hi, this is Eric from BoundEvents. How can I help?
Hey, I accidentally bought a ticket twice.
Could I get a refund please?
Sure. Please read out your reference number and I can begin to process that right now.
Welcome to DC Medical. How can I help?
Sí, por supuesto que hablo español. ¿En qué puedo ayudarle?
Add the following snippet to the pages where you want the conversation widget to be.
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans throughout (low-confidence guess: an Inter-like grotesk). Chat bubbles use small regular-weight sentence-case body text; headlines 'Analyse/Evaluate your transcripts' and 'All agents currently support 32 languages.' are large bold sentence case with tight tracking, the first word or the '32 languages' line filled with a gradient; translations of the languages line float behind in a large light serif italic at varying blur and size; the embed snippet is monospace.
shots.what_happens: Long single shot built from in-shot layout reframes (w148-w245). A 'Server' pill grows into a circle and merges with the gradient orb (w151-w158), which shrinks into a chat avatar; the BoundEvents refund conversation types in word by word with left (user, grey orb) and right (agent, pink orb) bubbles, scrolling up as new ones arrive (w159-w198). The chat slides away to reveal 'Analyse your transcripts' between masked-scrolling lists of call summaries, the first word blur-swapping to 'Evaluate' (w199-w206); a transcript view scrolls with highlighted entities, collapses into an audio waveform player whose bars fill with colour as it plays (w207-w213); evaluation criteria and data collection cards stack behind a summary card with success/value chips (w214-w222). 'All agents currently support 32 languages.' appears while translations in other languages drift by in blurred serif, then the camera zooms through the letters 'ngu' (w223-w230). After a music-only stretch (no words between 77.82 s and 86.36 s), a DC Medical chat answers a Spanish question in Spanish; the orb sweeps in beside an 'Embed code' card, a cursor clicks copy and a 'Copied!' tooltip appears (w231-w245), and the card resolves into a small 'Need help? / Start a call' widget before the scene breaks apart into the next shot's image tiles. Small list and summary paragraph text is too small at sheet resolution to quote; the embed snippet was only partly legible and is not quoted.
shots.build_rebuild: Build one continuous HTML scene on an off-white background where each section is a component (chat bubbles with typewriter text keyed to VO word times, a blurred-headline word swap, a waveform player with a progress-fill gradient, stacked summary cards, a floating multilingual text field) and transition between them with GSAP layout reframes, blur crossfades and a final scale-up zoom through a headline glyph.

shots.shot_type_other: collage of stock/lifestyle footage tiles in rounded cards with UI status chips (footage + ui overlay)
shots.focal_element: A 2x2 grid of rounded footage tiles (aerial kayak, orange suitcase, parcel hand-off, older man in a game-like scene) with a column of SDK icons (Python, JavaScript, React, Swift) to its left, and pill chips 'Booking confirmed' / 'Purchase confirmed' appearing over the tiles.
shots.transition_other: The embed widget dissolves as the image tiles fly in from off-frame and assemble into the grid (tile assemble).
shots.typography: Pill chips with medium-weight sentence-case sans text in a white capsule with a thin blue/purple gradient outline; the chip text reveals left to right as if typed or masked in.
shots.what_happens: As the VO says 'leverage our SDK for creating apps, services' (w246-w253), the grid re-lays out repeatedly: the suitcase tile grows large and a 'Booking confirmed' chip pops onto it, then the layout shifts so the parcel hand-off tile enlarges with a 'Purchase confirmed' chip, the other tiles shrinking and sliding to make room. The SDK icon column stays pinned at the left edge of the grid.
shots.build_rebuild: Lay out four rounded video tiles in a CSS grid next to an icon column and, on each VO cue, animate grid-template sizes with a spring so one tile becomes dominant while a gradient-outlined status pill scales in and its label masks in left to right.
